scripts.build:extension: vite build --config vite.config.extension-host.ts --configLoader native && vite build --config vite.config.extension-facts.ts --configLoader native && vite build --config vite.config.extension-mcp.ts --configLoader native && npm run build:viewer
scripts.test:engine: npm run verify:archcheck-engine && node tools/archcheck-engine-smoke.mjs && npm run test:engine-unit
scripts.test:engine-unit: cd engine && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.package:extension: npm run verify:archcheck-engine && npm run build:extension && cd extension && vsce package --no-dependencies --target win32-x64
scripts.test: npm run test:engine-unit && node tools/identifier-guard.mjs && node tools/i18n-guard.mjs && node tools/mcp-smoke.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tools/core-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/facts-view-smoke.ts && npm run test:extension
scripts.test:extension: npm run build:extension && node tools/extension-smoke.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tools/facts-panel-smoke.ts && npm run build:site && node --experimental-strip-types tools/site-smoke.ts
scripts.build:viewer: vite build --config vite.config.viewer.ts --configLoader native && node tools/build-viewer.mjs
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p extension/tsconfig.json --pretty false
